role: reusable two-expert causal mixture and experimental wrapper; not a separate discovery family

experts.D: causal treatment integer probability count derived from decoder-visible state
experts.sleeping_behavior: When D is inactive it must emit exactly P's count, making the mixture and posterior update algebraically neutral.

contract.common_probability_scale: P and D supply counts cP and cD in [1,C-1] under the exact same integer coder scale C.

ideal_reference.sequence_bound: Ideal unquantized Bayesian sequence log loss is at most min(L_P,L_D)+1 bit for two experts with equal prior.
ideal_reference.authority_boundary: The bound does not establish finite arithmetic archive size, Q63 rounding loss, switching/reset cost, package cost, runtime, memory, or enwik9 gain.

finite_codec_realization.name: global_q63_bayes_two_expert
finite_codec_realization.intermediate_width: unsigned integer width sufficient for every declared product; reference uses arbitrary precision and native implementation must prove equality or bind divergence
finite_codec_realization.truth_count: c when y=1 and C-c when y=0
finite_codec_realization.posterior_scope: one global posterior from first coded bit through terminal payload; no block, segment, article, or file reset

arms.K: wrapper active with D exactly equal to P; mixed count, posterior, integer probability stream, coder state, payload, archive, and parent state must equal P
arms.M: Q63 mixture of P and D

proof_ladder: tiny exhaustive integer-equation population against arbitrary-precision reference
250KB P/K exactness and finite archive diagnostic
1MB P/D/M calibration with ideal-reference regret accounting
opening and distant 10MB actual archives only after exactness
100MB and 1G only when package-aware economics pass

activation_requirements: selected execution host has no active exclusive_full1g lease
P and D are independently content-addressed causal predictors
integer probability scale and range-coder quantization are frozen
arbitrary-precision reference and Q63 implementation have a frozen comparison population
external resource guard and dependency-closure receipts are bound
claim_boundary: Ideal regret is mathematical reference evidence only.
Only M's actual finite archive can establish compression value.
A joint mixture archive replaces, rather than adds, separate expert savings.
Switching and specialist priors require a separately versioned successor.
